description: Release-gate evaluation set for the rules assistant. Categories cover every rule family, all eight reviewed languages, answer-language consistency, general proofreading and conventions, policy-vs-grammar separation, unsupported questions, prompt injection, draft-access refusal, conflicting-language questions, multi-rule answers, and the table-shaped rules, whose whole lookup table has to reach the answer rather than the one pair their reviewed example is.
